task: Decorating a pen holder with stickers
query: How do I decorate a pen holder with stickers?

goal.title: Decorate a pen holder with stickers
goal.description: Wipe a translucent cup, prepare and peel assorted graphic and text stickers, press them onto different faces and smooth the edges. Finish with smaller accents, then place two pens in the decorated cup.
goal.final_state: The decorated cup stands on the wooden desk holding teal and purple pens.

procedure.description: Lift the translucent cup and wipe its wall and base with a white tissue, turning it in the left hand before lowering it onto the wooden desk.

Fold and put the tissue aside, spread the die-cut stickers, and use large teal scissors to trim the straight bottom edge of a black-and-white text sticker. Put it down, sort several designs and select an orange outlined triangular graphic.
Repeatedly pick at the orange sticker edge until its white backing separates. Pick up the cup, align the graphic on its side, press it down and rub its edges while rotating the cup.

Set the cup down and choose the large conservation figure sticker. Work its edge and peel away the backing. Lift the cup, align then lift and realign the graphic on another face, and press its center and outline flat before putting the cup down.
Choose the green-and-orange text sticker, peel its backing and retrieve the cup. Turn a blank face toward the sticker, apply it diagonally and smooth the individual letters and edges.

Gather discarded backing paper and retrieve the trimmed black-and-white text sticker. Make repeated fingernail attempts before removing its backing. Lift the cup, position and reposition the label across another face, then smooth it and nearby overlapping edges.

Peel a small purple accent and press it near the upper rim; then peel a red heart and attach it below the text. Set the cup down, sort scraps and remaining stickers, briefly lift and return the scissors without visible cutting, and choose another small purple animal-shaped design.

Continue working the same small purple sticker edge for an extended time, finally separating its backing at about 223s. Lower the backing, grasp and lift the cup, and bring the sticker to the open area below the colored text.

Press the small purple graphic flat, rub its edges and rotate the cup to smooth the other attached stickers. Stand the decorated cup on the desk, retrieve the teal and purple pens, and lower both pens into it at about 245.1–245.5s. The final view shows the pen-filled decorated cup.
